ITEM.PTXT: The coil spring is separate from the shock absorber and is mounted lower, and a pigtail coil shape is used to reduce size and weight, accommodating the low floor package. In addition, spring insulators are provided at both the upper and lower ends of the spring, and their thickness is optimized to provide excellent vibration isolation and ride comfort.
The bound stopper is made of urethane to optimize the stopper characteristics.
